coverageNote: Main smoke, complete local-data Electron suite, both typechecks and production build passed on final source. No UI/style changes.
regressions: Quoted TSV records preserve multiline notes, blank lines, embedded tabs, escaped quotes, final rows and a single headerless row.
Instructions and phone numbers inside a quoted cell remain in the local source rather than description/history; explicit Content scope is unchanged.

Synthetic clipboard paste on the real Electron renderer stores the exact TSV source, opens the existing TXT/table Upload path, imports both recipients and preserves names, phones, leading zeros and Info1.
Save/reopen retains both imported rows and source refs; reopening Upload and the next metadata-only request do not leak multiline notes or recipients.
Existing CSV boundary, pending-attachment, large-paste, local file/image, cancellation and import draft regressions pass.
limitations: Electron uses fixture IPC/stores/provider and synthetic clipboard events, not a live Excel application or production provider/DB.
Only the local-data Electron suite reran for this parser fix, not the full unrelated campaign-form suite.
No Windows installer or manual production-app verification in this fix.
database: No migration/RPC/ACL/connection changes or DB apply
release: Source and local production build only; no installer/release
